# City-Data

> > Comprehensive database of U.S. city profiles featuring demographics, real estate data, crime statistics, cost of living, schools, and local business information.

City-Data provides detailed statistical profiles for thousands of American cities and towns, from major metropolitan areas to small communities. The site aggregates population data, housing markets, crime rates, school information, and local economic indicators to help users research relocation, real estate decisions, and community comparisons.

## Key Topics

- Demographics and population statistics
- Real estate and housing data
- Cost of living comparisons
- Crime statistics and safety
- City profiles and directories
- Household income data
- School information and ratings
- Arizona cities (Phoenix, Lake Havasu City, Tucson)
- Alabama cities and communities
- New York communities (Bellmore, Long Island)
- Local businesses and services
- Relocation and moving resources
- Community characteristics
- Municipal data aggregation
- Urban and suburban analysis

## State City Directories

- [Alabama Bigger Cities (over 6000 residents) - Real Estate, Housing, Schools, Residents, Crime, Pollution, Demographics and More](https://www.city-data.com/city/Alabama.html): Directory of Alabama cities over 6000 residents with demographics & stats
- [Arizona Bigger Cities (over 6000 residents) - Real Estate, Housing, Schools, Residents, Crime, Pollution, Demographics and More](https://www.city-data.com/city/Arizona.html): Directory of Arizona cities over 6000 residents with demographics & stats
